rules: Explain motivations before or alongside consequential decisions when the source permits.
Distinguish event chronology from revelation chronology; do not spoil later revelations.
Prioritize causal memories, relationships and character development over decorative details.
Mark unverified ages and chapter locations; never invent precise facts.
Maintain original narration and distinguish interpretation from source facts.
Use approximately ten chapters per production block, adjusting at natural narrative boundaries.
Keep stable character form identifiers and scene image mappings.
review_questions: What does the audience need to know now?
